subject: Music Production
title: The Neptunes' Sonic Signature
description: A fast breakdown of The Neptunes' Sonic Signature for builders.

hook.text: Pharrell Williams and Chad Hugo formed The Neptunes in Virginia Beach during high school.

buildup.text: They built beats from unusual sounds: shakers, keyboard stabs, and sparse dry drum patterns.

discovery.text: The Neptunes produced nearly half of all songs on US radio at their commercial peak in 2003.

twist.text: Despite dominating charts, they never repeated a formula and reinvented their sound each year.

climax.text: Their influence spread from hip-hop to pop to rock as artists across genres sought their touch.

punchline.text: Two high schoolers produced half of all radio hits.

quiz.question: What share of US radio did The Neptunes produce at their peak?
